items.title: Clayton Duerr Interview, 1972-04-17
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ... I can't place it, Bill. [INTERVIEWEE] I don't know.

ctx.x: Gussack, yes. See, I thought it was Ben too, he said Ben, but he might have been something else.
Gussack, yes. Did you know Jack Maysell played drums? Maysell. Maysell? Maysell? I can't place it, Bill.
